title: Address
description: A shipping or billing address on an order. Country and region decide tax and shipping; the rest is for display. Used as a card.
formgrid:
name company
line1 line2
city region
postalCode country
phone phone

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

name.label: Name
name.help: The person the order is for.

region.label: State or Region
region.help: The state, province or region code, such as CA. Decides tax and shipping with the country.

country.label: Country
country.help: Two-letter country code, such as US or DE. Decides tax and shipping.
